summary: Davidson County tower listed as DAT001 at 870 ft and marked removed; a Facebook post places a lookout in Germantown, Tennessee, without a county.

facts.status_note: The Tennessee tower list marks the tower removed. No source describes the site today.

events.note: The Tennessee tower list marks the tower removed.

evidence.supports: Tower DAT001 named Germantown in Davidson County at 870 ft, marked removed, numbered 6-7
Tower numbers such as 6-7 are district-tower numbers from a 1976 list

notes_for_editor: The Tennessee Landforms list places DAT001 in Davidson County. The Facebook post (Dennis Wolf Fire Pictures group) was readable only as its headline behind a login wall, so its date, county and details are unknown; it says 'Germantown, Tennessee' and the list says Davidson, so the two may or may not be the same tower. The story says so. The Nashville Historical Newsletter article on Germantown has no tower mention. The MPS lists Sullivan Ridge (DAT002, Davidson) as ruinous, which is a different tower. No build date, staffing, fire, photo or access source found. Brief's 265.2 m matches 870 ft.
